---
title: "Simple model for predicting interactions using random forest"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidylog)
```

```{r}
obs.mat <- read_csv(here::here("interaction/data/Swiss_web_gen_strict.csv")) 
dim(obs.mat) #rows and cols
obs.mat.long <- obs.mat |>
    rename(plant = ...1) |>
    pivot_longer(cols = -plant, names_to = "butterfly", values_to = "interaction")

taxa <- read_csv(here::here("interaction/taxa_list_hmsc.csv"), col_names = FALSE)
butterflies <- taxa$X1[!is.na(taxa$X1)] |> unique()
plants <- taxa$X3[!is.na(taxa$X3)] |> unique() 

obs.mat.hmsc.long <- obs.mat.long |> 
  filter(plant %in% plants & butterfly %in% butterflies) 

obs.mat.hmsc <- obs.mat.hmsc.long |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = butterfly, values_from = interaction) |>
  column_to_rownames("plant")

dim(obs.mat.hmsc) #rows and cols
sum(obs.mat.hmsc) #number of interactions
nrow(obs.mat.hmsc) * ncol(obs.mat.hmsc) #number of cells
sum(obs.mat.hmsc) / (nrow(obs.mat.hmsc) * ncol(obs.mat.hmsc)) # sparsity / connectance
```

Split data into train/test BEFORE computing SVD and phylogenetic features
Hold out 15% of the 1s (observed interactions) for testing, and 15% of the 0s in training
```{r}
set.seed(7)

# Split interactions: 85% train, 15% test
ones_train <- obs.mat.hmsc.long |> filter(interaction == 1) |> sample_frac(0.85)
ones_test  <- anti_join(obs.mat.hmsc.long |> filter(interaction == 1), ones_train)

# Training set: all zeros + 85% of ones
zeros_train <- obs.mat.hmsc.long |> filter(interaction == 0) |> sample_frac(0.85)
train_data <- bind_rows(zeros_train, ones_train)

# Test set: 15% of held-out ones + sample of zeros for evaluation
zeros_test <- zeros_train |> sample_frac(0.2)  # sample 20% of zeros for fair test set
test_data <- bind_rows(zeros_test, ones_test)

cat("Training set size:", nrow(train_data), "| ones:", sum(train_data$interaction), "\n")
cat("Test set size:", nrow(test_data), "| ones:", sum(test_data$interaction), "\n")

length(unique(train_data$plant)) # number of unique plants in training
length(unique(train_data$butterfly)) # number of unique butterflies in training
length(unique(test_data$plant)) # number of unique plants in test
length(unique(test_data$butterfly)) # number of unique butterflies in test

# Create matrices for SVD computation ONLY from training data
mat.train <- train_data |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = butterfly, values_from = interaction, values_fill = 0) |>
  column_to_rownames("plant") |> as.matrix()
```

Extract latent positions for plants and butterflies using SVD on training data only
```{r}
k = 10
svdk <- svd(mat.train, nu = k, nv = k)

plants.latent <- svdk$u %*% diag(sqrt(svdk$d[1:k])) # Plant Latent Positions (n x k)
rownames(plants.latent) <- rownames(mat.train)
colnames(plants.latent) <- c(paste0("pl_svd", 1:ncol(plants.latent)))
plants.latent.df <- plants.latent |> as.data.frame() |> 
  rownames_to_column("pl_taxa")

leps.latent <- svdk$v %*% diag(sqrt(svdk$d[1:k])) # Butterflies Latent Positions (m x k)
rownames(leps.latent) <- colnames(mat.train)
colnames(leps.latent) <- c(paste0("bf_svd", 1:ncol(leps.latent)))
leps.latent.df <- leps.latent |> as.data.frame() |> 
  rownames_to_column("bf_taxa")

#retrieve the probability matrix
P_hat <- plants.latent %*% t(leps.latent)
#assign row and column names to the reconstructed matrix
rownames(P_hat) <- rownames(mat.train)
colnames(P_hat) <- colnames(mat.train)
```

```{r}
Phat_long <- P_hat |> as.data.frame() |> 
  rownames_to_column("pl_taxa") |>
  pivot_longer(-pl_taxa, names_to = "bf_taxa", values_to = "Predicted") |> 
  left_join(obs.mat.hmsc.long, by = c("bf_taxa" = "butterfly", "pl_taxa" = "plant"))

library(cutpointr)

cutpoint <- cutpointr(Phat_long, 
    x = Predicted, class = interaction, 
    pos_class = 1,
    method = maximize_metric, 
    metric = youden)
cutpoint$optimal_cutpoint

Phat_long$Predicted_co <- ifelse(Phat_long$Predicted >= cutpoint$optimal_cutpoint, 1, 0)

# Check model performance with confusion matrix

library(caret)
# Calculate main performance metrics
confusionMatrix(factor(Phat_long$Predicted_co), factor(Phat_long$interaction),
                positive = "1")

```

## Add phylogeny

Butterflies tree (Re-check the origin of the tree)

```{r}
library(ape)
library(ggtree)
phylo.leps <- read.tree(here::here("interaction/data/GRAFTED_POST_DIST_EUROPEAN_MCC.nwk"))
ggtree(phylo.leps, layout = "circular") + geom_tiplab(size = 1.5)
```

```{r}
# Butterfly species with interaction AND phylogeny data
sum(butterflies %in% phylo.leps$tip.label)
# Butterflies not present in the phylogeny 
setdiff(butterflies, phylo.leps$tip.label)

# Change these four species names on tips of phylogeny for their synonims
phylo.leps$tip.label[phylo.leps$tip.label == "Polygonia_c-album"] <- "Polygonia_c.album"
phylo.leps$tip.label[phylo.leps$tip.label == "Satyrium_w-album"] <- "Satyrium_w.album"

setdiff(butterflies, phylo.leps$tip.label)
```

Plant tree (Re-check the origin of the tree)

```{r}
phylo.plants <- read.tree(here("interaction/data/seedplant_genera_tree_young.tre"))
# ggtree(phylo.plants, layout = "circular")
summary(phylo.plants$edge.length) #in Mya?
```

```{r}
phylo.plants$tip.label <- word(phylo.plants$tip.label, 3,3, sep = "_")
# Butterfly species with interaction AND phylogeny data
sum(plants %in% phylo.plants$tip.label)
# Plant genera not present in the phylogeny
setdiff(plants, phylo.plants$tip.label)
```

Keep only butterfly and plant taxa from training data in the trees
```{r}
# Get taxa present in TRAINING data only
train_butterflies <- unique(train_data$butterfly)
train_plants <- unique(train_data$plant)

phylo.leps.train <- ape::keep.tip(phylo.leps,
   intersect(phylo.leps$tip.label, train_butterflies), 
   trim.internal = TRUE)

phylo.plants.train <- ape::keep.tip(phylo.plants,
   intersect(phylo.plants$tip.label, train_plants), 
   trim.internal = TRUE)

cat("Training butterflies in phylogeny:", length(phylo.leps.train$tip.label), "\n")
cat("Training plants in phylogeny:", length(phylo.plants.train$tip.label), "\n")
```

Phylogenetic decomposition of the trees to get eigenvectors (from training data only).

```{r}
leps_decomp <- PVR::PVRdecomp(phy = phylo.leps.train, type = "newick", scale=TRUE)

#variance explained by each eigenvector
leps_decomp@Eigen$values |> 
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(eigenv = row_number()) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = eigenv, y = value)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  labs(title = "LEPS variance explained by eigenvectors (training data)") +
  theme_minimal() 

leps_decomp@Eigen$values |> 
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(var_explaines = value/sum(value)*100,
         cum_var_explained = cumsum(value)/sum(value)*100,
         eigenv = row_number()) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = eigenv, y = cum_var_explained)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  labs(title = "LEPS variance explained by eigenvectors (training data)") +
  theme_minimal()

sum((round((leps_decomp@Eigen$values)/sum((leps_decomp@Eigen$values)),3)*100)[1:10]) 
#first 10 vectors contain about X% of variation

phylo.dc.leps <- data.frame(phylo.leps.train$tip.label, leps_decomp@Eigen$vectors[,1:10])
colnames(phylo.dc.leps) <- c("bf_taxa", paste0("bf_phylo_ev", 1:10))
```

```{r}
plants_decomp <- PVR::PVRdecomp(phy = phylo.plants.train, type = "newick", scale=TRUE)

plants_decomp@Eigen$values |> 
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(eigenv = row_number()) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = eigenv, y = value)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  labs(title = "PLANTS variance explained by eigenvectors (training data)") +
  theme_minimal() 

plants_decomp@Eigen$values |> 
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(var_explaines = value/sum(value)*100,
         cum_var_explained = cumsum(value)/sum(value)*100,
         eigenv = row_number()) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = eigenv, y = cum_var_explained)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  labs(title = "PLANTS variance explained by eigenvectors (training data)") +
  theme_minimal() 

sum((round((plants_decomp@Eigen$values)/sum((plants_decomp@Eigen$values)),3)*100)[1:10]) 
#first 10 vectors contain about X% of variation

phylo.dc.plants <- data.frame(phylo.plants.train$tip.label, plants_decomp@Eigen$vectors[,1:10])
colnames(phylo.dc.plants) <- c("pl_taxa", paste0("pl_phylo_ev", 1:10))
```

## Random forest model

Build training dataset with features from training data only
```{r}
library(randomForest)

df.train <- train_data |> 
  left_join(leps.latent.df, by = c("butterfly" = "bf_taxa")) |> 
  left_join(plants.latent.df, by = c("plant" = "pl_taxa")) |>
  left_join(phylo.dc.leps, by = c("butterfly" = "bf_taxa")) |> 
  left_join(phylo.dc.plants, by = c("plant" = "pl_taxa")) |> 
  mutate(int_fct = as.factor(interaction)) |> 
  filter(!is.na(bf_svd1) & !is.na(pl_svd1)) |> # remove rows with missing values in the latent positions
  filter(!is.na(bf_phylo_ev1) & !is.na(pl_phylo_ev1)) # remove rows with missing values in phylogenetic info
```

```{r}
# Build test dataset using features learned from training data
df.test <- test_data |> 
  left_join(leps.latent.df, by = c("butterfly" = "bf_taxa")) |> 
  left_join(plants.latent.df, by = c("plant" = "pl_taxa")) |>
  left_join(phylo.dc.leps, by = c("butterfly" = "bf_taxa")) |> 
  left_join(phylo.dc.plants, by = c("plant" = "pl_taxa")) |> 
  mutate(int_fct = as.factor(interaction)) |> 
  filter(!is.na(bf_svd1) & !is.na(pl_svd1)) |> 
  filter(!is.na(bf_phylo_ev1) & !is.na(pl_phylo_ev1))
```

```{r}
m1 <- randomForest(int_fct ~. -butterfly -plant -interaction,
                      data = df.train, ntree = 1000,
                      importance = TRUE)
m1
importance(m1)
varImpPlot(m1)
# plot(m1)

# Predict on test set
pred_test <- predict(m1, newdata = df.test, type = "class")
pred_test_prob <- predict(m1, newdata = df.test, type = "prob")[, "1"]

# Evaluate on test data
library(caret)
confusionMatrix(pred_test, df.test$int_fct, positive = "1")
```

```{r}
#Predict also on training set to check for overfitting
pred_train_prob <- predict(m1, newdata = df.train, type = "prob")[, "1"]

# Combine train and test predictions with labels
results <- bind_rows(
  df.train.phylo |>
    mutate(
      prob = pred_train_prob,
      dataset = "Training",
      true_interaction = as.numeric(int_fct) - 1  # Convert factor back to 0/1
    ),
  df.test.phylo |>
    mutate(
      prob = pred_test_prob,
      dataset = "Test",
      true_interaction = as.numeric(int_fct) - 1
    )
)

# Plot: predicted probabilities by dataset and true interaction status
ggplot(results, aes(x = prob, y = dataset, color = as.factor(true_interaction))) +
  geom_jitter(height = 0.2, alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("0" = "grey70", "1" = "red"),
    labels = c("0" = "No interaction", "1" = "True interaction")) +
  labs(
    title = "Phylogenetic Model: Predicted Probabilities on Train vs TestData",
    x = "Predicted Probability",
    y = "Dataset",
    color = "True Label") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r}
# Predictions on training data
pred_train_prob <- predict(m.phylo1, newdata = df.train.phylo, type = "prob")[, "1"]

# Predictions on test data (already computed)
pred_test_prob <- predict(m.phylo1, newdata = df.test.phylo, type = "prob")[, "1"]

# Combine train and test predictions with labels
results <- bind_rows(
  df.train.phylo |>
    mutate(
      prob = pred_train_prob,
      dataset = "Training",
      true_interaction = as.numeric(int_fct) - 1  # Convert factor back to 0/1
    ),
  df.test.phylo |>
    mutate(
      prob = pred_test_prob,
      dataset = "Test",
      true_interaction = as.numeric(int_fct) - 1
    )
)

# Plot: predicted probabilities by dataset and true interaction status
ggplot(results, aes(x = prob, y = dataset, color = as.factor(true_interaction))) +
  geom_jitter(height = 0.2, alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("0" = "grey70", "1" = "red"),
    labels = c("0" = "No interaction", "1" = "True interaction")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Phylogenetic Model: Predicted Probabilities on Train vs Test Data",
    x = "Predicted Probability",
    y = "Dataset",
    color = "True Label"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# Summary statistics
results |> group_by(dataset, true_interaction) |>
  mutate(cat_int = ifelse(prob > 0.5, 1, 0)) |>  
  summarise(mean_prob = mean(prob), sd_prob = sd(prob), n = n(), n_correct = sum(cat_int == true_interaction)) |>
  mutate(accuracy = n_correct/n) |>
  arrange(dataset, true_interaction) |>
  print()
```

## Model using full dataset with only phylogenetic distance

```{r}
df.model <- obs.mat.hmsc.long |> 
  # left_join(leps.latent.df, by = c("butterfly" = "bf_taxa")) |>
  # left_join(plants.latent.df, by = c("plant" = "pl_taxa")) |>
  left_join(phylo.dc.leps, by = c("butterfly" = "bf_taxa")) |>
  left_join(phylo.dc.plants, by = c("plant" = "pl_taxa")) |>
  mutate(int_fct = as.factor(interaction)) |>
  filter(!is.na(bf_phylo_ev1)) |> 
  filter(!is.na(pl_phylo_ev1)) # remove rows with missing values in phylogenetic info

m.phylo_full <- randomForest(int_fct ~. -butterfly -plant -interaction,
                            data = df.model, ntree = 1000,
                            importance = TRUE)
m.phylo_full
# importance(m.phylo_full)
varImpPlot(m.phylo_full)

pred_full_prob <- predict(m.phylo_full, newdata = df.model, type = "prob")[, "1"]

ggplot(df.model, aes(x = pred_full_prob, y = interaction)) +
  geom_jitter(height = 0.2, alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Phylogenetic Model: Predicted Probabilities on Full Dataset",
    x = "Predicted Probability",
    y = "Original Interaction"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

write.csv(df.model |> mutate(predicted_prob = pred_full_prob), 
          here::here("interaction/output/RF_phylo_model_predictions.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
